limitations: RTC runs on localhost. Signaling requests are aborted by browser interception; the server process and TURN service are not restarted.
Browser harness drives simulation with timers and invokes rendering explicitly; no sustained GPU or frame-time benchmark.
Backpressure tests control mock SCTP buffers; real internet congestion and TURN fallback still need qualification.
The short soak uses an accelerated simulated clock and scripted fixtures; it is not a real-time human gameplay session.
Public HTTPS/TURN, separate networks, actual host tab visibility behavior, solo combat/economy migration and gameplay parity remain open.
